name: B10-0515/2025 (S&D) – Post-election killings and the deteriorating human rights situation in Tanzania, including the case of imprisoned opposition leader Tundu Lissu
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the post-election killings and deteriorating human rights situation in Tanzania, including the case of imprisoned opposition leader Tundu Lissu
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and calling for action. It asks Tanzania to release opposition leader Tundu Lissu and other people held without trial, and to stop the violence against protesters and critics after the October 2025 election. It also asks the European Commission to review the help the EU gives Tanzania and to put more support into human rights groups and journalists.

- No law changes; the Parliament only states its position and makes requests.
- It affects Tanzania's government, detained opposition figures, protesters and journalists.
- Next, the EU is asked to raise these issues with Tanzania and review its aid.
